segments.name: Direct origination
segments.description: Direct lender originating senior secured loans to privately held, lower middle market companies in the United States.
segments.evidence: The Company operates through a single reporting segment, with an investment strategy to generate current income and, to a lesser extent, capital appreciation primarily through direct origination of senior secured debt and select equity investments.

revenueModel.text: Portfolio companies pay the company interest, origination and other fees, and dividends on its loans and securities.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate current income through the receipt of interest payments, as well as origination and other fees, capital appreciation and dividends.
